diagnostics.message: The CloudTrail trail created by module.cloudtrail_baseline (aws_cloudtrail.global) receives the audit-log bucket name as a plain string, so Terraform infers no dependency on the bucket policy. CloudTrail's CreateTrail API validates that the S3 bucket policy permits cloudtrail.amazonaws.com; if :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log has not been applied yet, trail creation fails with InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException. The aws_s3_bucket_policy should be created before the trail is created (the provider's own documentation shows a bare `depends_on` on the bucket policy for exactly this race).

The AWS Config recorder started by module.config_baseline_ap-northeast-1 (aws_config_configuration_recorder_status.recorder) uses a delivery channel whose s3_bucket_name is passed in as a plain string, so there is no dependency on the audit-log bucket policy. Starting the configuration recorder requires the S3 bucket policy to permit config.amazonaws.com delivery; if :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log is applied after this module, StartConfigurationRecorder fails with InsufficientDeliveryPolicyException. The bucket policy must be in place before the recorder is started.
